segments.normalizedSource: ```swift @MainActor func updateEntity(_ entity: ModelEntity) throws { /// The texture based on the seed values. guard let texture = ProceduralTextureGenerator.generate(seed) else { return } /// The texture of the sampler, to the nearest pixel. var sampler = PhysicallyBasedMaterial.Texture.Sampler() sampler.modify { $0.magFilter = .nearest } /// The material that simulates the appearance of real-world objects. var material = PhysicallyBasedMaterial() /// The texture for the material. let textureAndSampler = PhysicallyBasedMaterial.Texture( texture, sampler: sampler ) material.baseColor = PhysicallyBasedMaterial.BaseColor(texture: textureAndSampler) // Apply the material to the model of the entity. entity.model?.materials = [material] entity.components[DrawableQueueComponent.self] = try DrawableQueueComponent(texture: texture) } ```
